events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, Abbey Road, in the UK on September 26, 1969. It arrived in the U.S. on October 1, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: That iconic zebra crossing! The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' album dropped in 1969, featuring one of the most famous album covers ever. Which track is your favourite?

events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the legendary lead singer of Queen, was born Farrokh Bulsara on this day in 1946 in Zanzibar.

angles.name: Tribute to a Legend
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 today. His incredible voice and stage presence continue to inspire. What's your ultimate Queen anthem?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, American-British singer, songwriter, and founding member of The Pretenders, was born on this day in 1951.

angles.name: Birthday Rocker
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and songwriting have powered The Pretenders for decades. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive frontman of Oasis and later Beady Eye, was born on this day in 1972 in Manchester.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! From Oasis anthems to his solo hits, his swagger is unmistakable. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine single released
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless single 'Imagine' was released on October 11, 1971, in the US and October 24, 1971, in the UK.

angles.name: Timeless Anthem
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the release of John Lennon's powerful anthem 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: First iPod released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod, revolutionising portable music, on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: Tech Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? It changed how we listened to music forever! What was the first song you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first James Bond film, Dr. No, in London on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating over six decades of 007. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on this day in 1940 in Liverpool, England.

angles.name: Remembering a Visionary
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations worldwide. What's your most cherished Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: John Cleese, the legendary British actor, comedian, and screenwriter, was born on this day in 1939 in Weston-super-Mare, Somerset.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his unique humour is timeless. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album,' on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: The White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: A masterpiece of musical diversity! The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped in 1968, showcasing their incredible range. Which track from the double LP stands out for you?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, passed away on this day in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and spirit are truly unforgettable. What's the song that best captures his genius for you?

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Evolution of The Beatles
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in music history! The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' album was released in 1965, marking a significant artistic evolution. What's your favourite track from this era-defining record?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: John Lennon, a global music icon and peace activist, passed away on this day in 1980 at the age of 40.

angles.name: Legacy of Peace
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who left us on this day in 1980. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. What's his most enduring song for you?
